title: Blocking Assignment in Priority Update
bug_signature: VCS-WARNING: Blocking assignment to 'last_gnt' in always_ff; simulation/synthesis mismatch
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  last_gnt = current_gnt;  // Blocking '=' in sequential block
expected_root_cause: A blocking assignment (=) is used inside an always_ff block to update last_gnt, creating a race condition between the pointer update and any combinational logic that reads last_gnt in the same time step.
fix_replacement:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  last_gnt <= current_gnt;  // Non-blocking — correct for sequential
description: The priority pointer uses a blocking assignment inside always_ff, creating a race condition between the register update and any combinational logic that reads last_gnt in the same time step.
failure_log: VCS-WARNING: Blocking assignment to 'last_gnt' in always_ff; simulation/synthesis mismatch
success_log: No blocking assignment warnings. Synthesis and simulation agree.
